title: Tectonic exploit affects Cronos lending protocol
description: Tectonic was reported to have suffered a major exploit on Cronos. Contemporary reporting estimated approximately USD 74-75 million in affected or attacker-controlled assets and described TONIC price manipulation followed by borrowing against inflated collateral. Roughly USD 6 million was reported bridged to Ethereum before Cronos validators halted the network; most remaining exploit-linked assets were reported stranded or frozen on Cronos. Final loss, formal root cause and recovery remain unresolved.
